Each test names the test steps it decides.

strings.Images, icons, SVGs and controls have a: Images, icons, SVGs and controls have a text alternative. Whether each alternative is meaningful is judged by a person.
The UI contains no audio or video.
strings.ARIA, lists, tables, form labels, landma: ARIA, lists, tables, form labels, landmarks and heading levels are checked. Whether the structure matches the visual meaning is judged by a person.
strings.The reading order is compared with the v: The reading order is compared with the visual order. Whether the order makes sense is judged by a person.
strings.Texts are searched for instructions that: Texts are searched for instructions that rely on shape, position or colour alone. A person reviews the hits.
strings.Every page works in portrait and landsca: Every page works in portrait and landscape phone sizes and does not lock the orientation.
strings.Fields that ask for data about the user: Fields that ask for data about the user carry a valid autocomplete token.
strings.Links in text are distinguishable withou: Links in text are distinguishable without colour. Whether colour alone carries other information is judged by a person.
strings.Text contrast is measured on every page,: Text contrast is measured on every page, in every language, in the light and the dark theme.
strings.At 200 % zoom nothing scrolls sideways o: At 200 % zoom nothing scrolls sideways or is cut off, in every language.
strings.Images, canvases and CSS background imag: Images, canvases and CSS background images are checked for text rendered as pixels.
strings.At 320 CSS px width the page needs no ho: At 320 CSS px width the page needs no horizontal scrolling and loses no content, in every language.
strings.Form control borders and focus indicator: Form control borders and focus indicators reach 3:1. Charts and icons are judged by a person.
strings.The WCAG text spacing values are applied: The WCAG text spacing values are applied and no content is cut off.
strings.Tooltips and popups appear on focus, clo: Tooltips and popups appear on focus, close with Escape and stay while the pointer is on them.
strings.Every control is reached with the Tab ke: Every control is reached with the Tab key; popups, dialogs and tabs work with the keyboard.
strings.Tabbing through the page always leaves i: Tabbing through the page always leaves it again.
strings.Single printable keys pressed on the pag: Single printable keys pressed on the page trigger no action.
strings.No page refreshes, redirects or expires: No page refreshes, redirects or expires on its own while the user is reading.
strings.Nothing moves, blinks or updates endless: Nothing moves, blinks or updates endlessly on an idle page, and reduced motion is respected.
strings.The page is recorded over time; nothing: The page is recorded over time; nothing flashes more than three times per second.
strings.Every page has landmarks and a skip link: Every page has landmarks and a skip link to the main content.
strings.Every page has its own title, translated: Every page has its own title, translated into every language.
strings.Nothing hidden takes focus and no positi: Nothing hidden takes focus and no positive tabindex is used. Whether the order is logical is judged by a person.
strings.Every link has an accessible name. Wheth: Every link has an accessible name. Whether it describes the target is judged by a person.
strings.Every page is linked from the navigation: Every page is linked from the navigation of every page. Further ways are judged by a person.
strings.Headings and labels exist and are not em: Headings and labels exist and are not empty. Whether they are descriptive is judged by a person.
strings.Every Tab stop looks different with and: Every Tab stop looks different with and without focus, in the light and the dark theme.
strings.No control needs a multipoint or path-ba: No control needs a multipoint or path-based gesture; a single click is enough.
strings.Controls act when the pointer is release: Controls act when the pointer is released, not when it is pressed, so an action can be aborted.
strings.The visible label of every control is pa: The visible label of every control is part of its accessible name.
strings.The page does not react to device motion: The page does not react to device motion or orientation events.
strings.The lang attribute of the page names the: The lang attribute of the page names the language shown, on load and after switching language.
strings.Text in another language than the page i: Text in another language than the page is marked with its own lang attribute.
strings.Moving the focus never navigates, opens: Moving the focus never navigates, opens a window or otherwise changes the context.
strings.Changing a field or a selection does not: Changing a field or a selection does not navigate or change the context unexpectedly.
strings.The navigation is the same, in the same: The navigation is the same, in the same order, on every page.
strings.Controls with the same function have the: Controls with the same function have the same name on every page.
strings.Submitting empty or invalid forms marks: Submitting empty or invalid forms marks the fields and links a visible message in the page language. Whether the message is clear is judged by a person.
strings.Every field has a label. Whether the ins: Every field has a label. Whether the instructions are sufficient is judged by a person.
strings.Error messages are present and translate: Error messages are present and translated. Whether they suggest a fix is judged by a person.
strings.Deleting stored data asks for confirmati: Deleting stored data asks for confirmation or can be undone.
strings.IDs are unique and the markup has no par: IDs are unique and the markup has no parsing errors that affect assistive technology.
strings.Every control has a name, a valid role a: Every control has a name, a valid role and the states it needs.
strings.Status areas are live regions. Whether e: Status areas are live regions. Whether each status change is announced is judged by a person.
